subject: Mathematics
title: A Tale of Three Intersecting Lines

questions.q: What is the sum of the angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The angles of any triangle add up to 180°.

questions.q: Which set of sides can form a triangle?
questions.explanation: The sum of any two sides must be greater than the third side: 5 + 7 > 10.

questions.q: An exterior angle of a triangle equals the ____.
options: half of the sum of all angles
sum of the two opposite interior angles
questions.explanation: This is the exterior angle property.
